AWTechs / Perch

Privacy policy.

Effective 1 October 2026

Scope

This policy describes the public Perch website operated by AWTechs and the distinction between that website and self-hosted Perch installations.

This website

The website provides information and links. It has no account registration, payment collection, command execution, optional analytics, tracking pixels or application cookies. AWTechs does not request your VPS credentials or receive your command history through this website.

The hosting provider processes network requests needed to serve the website, which can include IP addresses, request times, browser information and requested URLs. Its infrastructure logging, retention and data handling follow the provider's policies and configuration. This site does not promise a separate retention period for provider-controlled logs.

Your self-hosted server

Perch stores client registration and authentication data, approval decisions, saved approval rules, command requests and results on the infrastructure where you install it. Retention, backups, access and deletion are controlled by the server operator. The public website does not relay that data to AWTechs.

Connecting an AI or MCP client allows that client to submit requests and receive results from your server. Commands and output may therefore be processed by that client's provider under its own policies. Avoid sharing sensitive output unless you intend to do so.

Support and external services

If you open a GitHub issue, the information you submit is processed by GitHub and is normally public. Do not include secrets or personal information. Links to GitHub, ChatGPT and other services are governed by their respective policies.

Retention and deletion

Manage self-hosted records and backups on your own server. Manage GitHub support content through GitHub's controls. For a privacy question concerning this website, use the support page and describe the concern without publishing sensitive details.

Changes

Updates to this policy will be published on this page with a revised effective date.
